title: Screening of diagnostic biomarkers for taurine metabolism-related genes in lupus nephritis and analysis of immune infiltration.
authors: Cheng, Dong; Xu, Xiaoyan; Lang, Xujun; He, Yangbiao; Fan, Kaijie
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习筛选狼疮肾炎牛磺酸代谢相关诊断基因并分析免疫浸润，虽涉及转录因子调控网络预测，但核心是疾病诊断标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法上无AI/物理模拟的互作机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Lupus nephritis (LN) represents a serious renal manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus and is driven by intricate interactions among immune dysregulation, inflammatory responses, and metabolic alterations. Recent studies have found that the metabolic dysregulation of taurine contributes to the progression of renal injury by impairing its antioxidant and immunomodulatory functions. METHODS: This study utilized microarray data of LN from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database and applied three Machine Learning (ML) algorithms-Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator, Support Vector Machine, and Boruta-to screen key genes and construct a diagnostic model. The model was validated both internally and externally. Single-Sample Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (ssGSEA) and the CIBERSORT algorithm were employed to assess the association between the model genes and immune infiltration. Additionally, potential biological mechanisms were explored through functional enrichment analysis, disease subtype classification, and prediction of the transcription factor regulatory network. RESULTS: This study identified two taurine metabolism-associated diagnostic genes (CCND1 and LYN) for LN via differential expression analysis and ML. The validated diagnostic model demonstrated high accuracy, while further analyses revealed their involvement in pro-inflammatory immune infiltration (e.g., increased monocytes/neutrophils) and immune-related pathways (e.g., NOD-like receptor signaling). LN patients were sub-classified into two immune-distinct subtypes, and upstream regulators (e.g., STAT3, TP53) of CCND1 were predicted. CONCLUSION: This study identified CCND1 and LYN as promising diagnostic biomarkers for lupus nephritis, linking them to dysregulated taurine metabolism and immune infiltration, thereby offering new insights into the disease's immunometabolic interplay and potential therapeutic avenues.
abstract_zh: 背景：狼疮性肾炎（LN）是系统性红斑狼疮的一种严重肾脏表现，其发病机制涉及免疫失调、炎症反应和代谢改变之间的复杂相互作用。近期研究发现，牛磺酸的代谢失调通过损害其抗氧化和免疫调节功能，促进肾损伤的进展。方法：本研究利用基因表达综合（GEO）数据库中LN的微阵列数据，并应用三种机器学习（ML）算法——最小绝对收缩和选择算子、支持向量机和Boruta——筛选关键基因并构建诊断模型。该模型在内部和外部均进行了验证。采用单样本基因集富集分析（ssGSEA）和CIBERSORT算法评估模型基因与免疫浸润之间的关联。此外，通过功能富集分析、疾病亚型分类和转录因子调控网络预测，探索了潜在的生物学机制。结果：本研究通过差异表达分析和ML，鉴定了两个与牛磺酸代谢相关的LN诊断基因（CCND1和LYN）。验证后的诊断模型显示出高准确性，进一步分析揭示它们参与促炎性免疫浸润（如单核细胞/中性粒细胞增加）和免疫相关通路（如NOD样受体信号传导）。LN患者被细分为两个免疫特征不同的亚型，并预测了CCND1的上游调控因子（如STAT3、TP53）。结论：本研究将CCND1和LYN鉴定为狼疮性肾炎的有前景的诊断生物标志物，将其与牛磺酸代谢失调和免疫浸润联系起来，从而为该疾病的免疫代谢相互作用及潜在治疗途径提供了新见解。
